# Made by Human

> Official machine-readable information about Made by Human for search and AI discovery.

Made by Human is a certification for physical products with verifiably human production. It evaluates whether the essential, product-defining manufacturing steps are carried out by people and makes certification status publicly verifiable.

German: Made by Human ist eine Zertifizierung für physische Produkte mit nachweisbar menschlicher Herstellung. Entscheidend ist, ob die wesentlichen, produktprägenden Herstellungsschritte tatsächlich von Menschen ausgeführt werden. Zertifizierungsstatus und Geltungsbereich sind öffentlich prüfbar.

Official website: https://madebyhuman.org/
English website: https://madebyhuman.org/en/
Operator: D&G Handels GmbH, Paderborn, Germany
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/madebyhuman.verify/
Official LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/made-by-human-org/

## Key facts

- Official name: Made by Human (singular).
- Physical products are the certification scope.
- Tools and machines may support production.
- The essential, product-defining manufacturing steps must be carried out by people under the standard.
- Certification is tied to the product or product family listed in the public certification record.
- Certification status is available through the public register and verification page.
- The current public German Standard 0.1 is the normative reference.
- The English standard page is an explanatory translation until an approved English normative version is published.
